blind.description: A compact cluster of stylized items including two ceramic jars (one ochre/clay, one reddish-brown with a gold band), a small shallow bowl filled with gold coins, a small circular bronze/gold shield or boss, and a sheathed dagger with gold pommel and fittings resting across a folded green cloth bundle. Surfaces are smooth, solid, and continuous with stylized hand-painted textures, naturally arranged together on the ground without an artificial base.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a tight cluster consisting of two circular pot openings side by side, a small round dish filled with yellow coins, a tiny round shield boss, and a dagger lying diagonally over a green fabric pouch.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/4 the height of the figure (around 1.3 to 1.5 feet tall) and roughly 2 feet wide.
